text: My main symptom is Headache. I also have Worsening vision over the past 3 weeks, No weight changes, No fevers, No night sweats, No other pain.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Giant Cell Arteritis (Temporal Arteritis).

Based on your age and the classic triad of new-onset headache, worsening vision, and the absence of infectious signs (fever, weight loss), I am highly concerned for vasculitis affecting the temporal arteries. Please seek emergency care immediately to prevent permanent vision loss, and we will proceed with a Temporal Artery Biopsy and ESR/CRP levels to confirm.
